tickets.title: `./install --with agy` wires agy to the HUD and uninstalls cleanly
tickets.what:
Proposal docs/neon-proposal/25-agy-adapter.md §2.1 (owner, 2026-11-22: installation may edit agy's own config; delivery A+B). New `install.d/agy.sh` modelled on `install.d/claude.sh`:
- registers the `hud` MCP with the official command (`agy mcp add --env HUD_MCP_SURFACE=roles hud "$BIN_DIR/hud-mcp"`);
- adds `mcp(hud/*)` to `permissions.allow` and the HUD `statusLine` to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`, keeping an owner's non-HUD statusline;
- registers the HUD PreInvocation hook through an official agy mechanism, sourced from `$HUD_HOME`. The hook script can be a no-op stub until 03, and herdr's own hook stays untouched.
- `--uninstall` reverses exactly what HUD wrote.
Also land the approved spec sentences:
- §1: Antigravity joins the list.
- §2.1.3: agy workers get the worker MCP, with the shell done-command fallback kept.
- §2.1.6: a working agy session gets events through its PreInvocation hook; an idle one has them typed into its prompt.
- §2.2.1: the agy statusline.
- §2.4: the `agy` extension.
Update reference.md and reference.zh.md.

acceptance.text: Install then uninstall against a temp HOME with synthetic agy config files leaves them byte-identical, apart from deliberately foreign edits made in between
Re-install is idempotent; an owner's own statusLine is kept
npm test, check:fixtures and test:release pass

tickets.title: agy workers report through the worker MCP
tickets.what:
Proposal 25 §2.2.
- `cliWorkerTools('agy')` is true: the brief's finishing line asks for `hud_report` with the turn token, and agy workers can use `hud_ask`, `hud_sonic`, `hud_progress` and `hud_lease`.
- The finishing prompt keeps the shell fallback `hud-progress.mjs --done … [--summary] [--file]` for a first turn where the tools are not loaded yet. agy loads plugin and global MCP lazily, and in the 2026-11-22 probe the first turn did not see the tool.
- Verify whether `eager: true` in mcp_config.json makes the tools available on turn one. Record the result; if it works, the 01 installer sets it.
- The MCP side reads `_meta["antigravity.google/conversation_id"]` as the session id.

acceptance.text: A fake-agy CLI worker test settles through hud_report; another settles through the shell fallback; both bind to the right turn

comments.author: main
comments.text: landed 9ce1fd81. agy workers finish with hud_report; shell fallback line kept. No launch change needed (HUD_JOB_DIR inherited). eager not tested live (needs an authenticated isolated HOME). herdr agent_session_id = _meta conversation_id by code reading. Suite 959/959.

tickets.title: An agy main session gets job events (A+B) and the resume guard
tickets.what:
Proposal 25 §2.3, owner 2026-11-22: A+B.
- The main-session tools work from agy as a client without MCP tasks.
- The resume guard covers agy: `_meta` conversation_id is matched against STATUS `agent_session_id`.
- **B:** the HUD PreInvocation hook script (registered by 01) finds the caller's undelivered job events and injects one short text via `injectSteps`, marking them delivered. With no events it prints `{}`, and it stays cheap and bounded.
- **A:** an idle agy pane gets events typed through the existing herdr typed path, only while idle.
- One delivery record is shared, so an event never arrives twice.

acceptance.text: A synthetic hook payload with a pending event gets one injection, and a second run gets `{}`
An idle fake-agy pane gets the typed event once, and a working one does not
The resume guard refuses a resumed agy worker

comments.author: main
comments.text: landed 93471a3e. Pending file $HUD_HOME/watchers/<pane>.agy-pending (0600, 16 KiB cap, flock + rename claim). Hook: 1.5 ms empty, ~50 ms with an event. Idle flush rides the watcher's existing wakes or its 30 s rescan, so an event that lands after a turn's last model call can wait up to ~30 s. Suite 967/967, release green.

tickets.title: hud-statusline renders agy's payload, fast enough for 3 Hz
tickets.what:
Proposal 25 §2.4.
- `hud-statusline` recognises `product: "antigravity"` and shows model, context % and tokens.
- It renders the `quota` buckets as quota watermarks, the same form as Codex's "5h 80% left".
- It skips transcript parsing for agy.
- It never shows or stores `email`.
- agy calls the command about every 300 ms while the screen changes. Measure the per-call cost and bring p50 to ≤ 30 ms, using the forward worker or a cache keyed on the input signature.
- A failure prints a short degraded line and exits 0, so agy does not disable the statusline.
- Use synthetic payload fixtures only. Shape: proposal 25 §1, re-probed with a session-only `--settings` statusLine if the quota bucket shape is needed.

acceptance.text: Synthetic agy payloads (fresh session, mid-turn, quota present) render the expected lines in EN/ZH
Timing reported before/after; npm test and check:fixtures pass
